newsitem.title: USA: San Diego, QUALCOMM close to stadium deal.
newsitem.headline: San Diego, QUALCOMM close to stadium deal.

text.p: The city of San Diego on Tuesday took a step closer to finalizing an $18 million agreement that would rename its stadium after a local communications company, officials said.

The proposal, which would change the name of San Diego's Jack Murphy Stadium to QUALCOMM Stadium at Jack Murphy Field, was approved in concept by the San Diego City Council at its meeting on Tuesday, a spokeswoman for the mayor said.
Under the terms of the deal, San Diego-based QUALCOMM Inc would pay the city $18 million in cash up-front to have its name on the stadium for the next 20 years.
